findings.description: The Lambda function embeds plaintext AWS access key (AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE) and secret key (wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY) directly in the environment variables. These credentials are visible in plaintext in the Terraform configuration and the deployed function configuration, leaking secrets to anyone with read access.
The Lambda function uses nodejs12.x runtime, which is deprecated and no longer receives security updates, leaving the function vulnerable to unpatched runtime vulnerabilities.

The Lambda environment variables are not configured with KMS encryption (no kms_key_arn set), so the variables are protected only by the AWS default Lambda encryption, and the hard-coded secret keys are not encrypted at rest with a customer-managed key.
